map.AST 与语法树、CST 是一回事吗？: Are an AST, a syntax tree and a CST the same thing?
map.不完全。CST（具体语法树）保留全部词法细节（括号、分号、注释），AST 则去掉: Not quite. A CST (concrete syntax tree) keeps every lexical detail — parentheses, semicolons, comments — whereas an AST drops nodes that do not affect meaning and keeps only the structure. Most transpilers and static analysis tools build on the AST because it is smaller and easier to traverse; a CST is only needed when formatting has to be lossless.
map.AST（Abstract Syntax Tree，抽象语法树）是源代码的抽象语法: An AST (Abstract Syntax Tree) is a tree-shaped representation of a program's abstract syntactic structure.
